biomarkers.name: MYC amplification (radiation-induced / post-lymphedema)
biomarkers.prevalence: Characteristic of secondary angiosarcoma, especially post-radiation and also reported in Stewart-Treves syndrome

biomarkers.name: CIC-rearranged sarcoma / CIC-DUX4 fusion
biomarkers.prevalence: Not a characteristic finding in conventional angiosarcoma; rare reports should prompt consideration of alternative diagnosis
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not a routine angiosarcoma biomarker; CIC-rearranged sarcoma is a distinct entity and should not be used as a standard angiosarcoma variant marker

biomarkers.name: CD31, CD34, ERG, FLI1
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually positive (endothelial markers), with CD31/ERG among the most sensitive/specific

biomarkers.name: PD-L1 / TMB (UV-associated cutaneous angiosarcoma)
biomarkers.prevalence: Higher TMB and UV mutational signature are enriched in cutaneous scalp/face angiosarcoma; PD-L1 expression is variable
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports potential sensitivity to immune checkpoint inhibition; pembrolizumab has activity in a subset

biomarkers.name: TP53, PTPRB, PLCG1, KDR
biomarkers.prevalence: Recurrently altered in subsets; no single mutation is uniformly common across all angiosarcomas

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Malignant endothelial cells forming vascular channels, sheets, or solid growth; often extensive haemorrhage
histomorphological_subtype.grading: By degree of differentiation and mitotic index

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: UV-associated scalp/face variants often have higher TMB/UV-signature and may show better responses to immune checkpoint inhibition; radiation-induced (MYC-amplified) is biologically distinct and less well defined immunologically
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Malignant endothelial channels with cellular tufting; hemorrhagic

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Endothelial cells (of blood vessels) or lymphatic endothelial cells for some variants
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — endothelial cells derive from mesodermal angioblasts
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Malignant endothelial cells expressing endothelial markers (CD31+, CD34+, ERG+, factor VIII+); often forming abortive vascular channels
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Multiple distinct entities united by endothelial differentiation: cutaneous scalp variant (UV-driven, high TMB), post-radiation (MYC amplification, distinct biology), post-lymphedema (Stewart-Treves), visceral (heart, liver, spleen)
